name: alloy-luau
description: Language support for Alloy, a strict superset of Luau

alloy-luau.server.path.description: Path to the alloy-lsp binary. Empty means ~/.alloy/bin/alloy-lsp when it exists, then alloy-lsp on PATH.

alloy-luau.types.definitionFiles.description: Declaration files (.d.aly or .d.luau) passed to the language server as --definitions. The Roblox globals of luau-lsp.types.roblox.securityLevel and the files of luau-lsp.types.definitionFiles are passed on their own.

alloy-luau.server.luauLspPath.description: Path to the luau-lsp binary alloy-lsp runs as its child. Empty means the binary of the luau-lsp extension when it is installed, then luau-lsp on PATH.

enumDescriptions: Failures only: a child that does not start, a stream that breaks.
Errors and warnings, such as an argument the server does not know.
Milestones, such as the workspace shadows opening.
Counts and decisions, such as semantic token remaps.
alloy-luau.server.logLevel.description: What alloy-lsp writes to the Alloy output channel. A change restarts the server.

alloy-luau.trace.server.description: Trace the messages between VS Code and alloy-lsp in the Alloy output channel. This is the client side; server.logLevel is the server side.

alloy-luau.inlayHints.variableTypes.description: Show the inferred type of a variable, including loop variables.

alloy-luau.inlayHints.parameterTypes.description: Show the inferred type of an untyped parameter.

alloy-luau.inlayHints.functionReturnType.description: Show the inferred return type of a function.

alloy-luau.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter names at call sites: never, for literal arguments, or always.

alloy-luau.completion.autocompleteEnd.description: After Enter on a line that opens a block, insert its `end` a line below the cursor: functions, if, loops, do, repeat, struct, enum, interface, trait, impl, macro, and match.

alloy-luau.sourcemap.file.description: The sourcemap the server reads for the DataModel, relative to the project root.

alloy-luau.sourcemap.autogenerate.description: Run the sourcemap generator command each time a script is saved.

alloy-luau.sourcemap.generatorCommand.description: The command that writes the sourcemap, run in the project root. ${sourcemapFile} is the sourcemap file setting, so the default is `rojo sourcemap --output sourcemap.json`.

alloy-luau.studioPlugin.enabled.description: Accept the luau-lsp Studio companion plugin, so the DataModel tree types game requires and instance paths in Alloy files. Off by default: the luau-lsp extension's own server may hold the port.

alloy-luau.studioPlugin.port.description: The port the Studio companion plugin connects to. Pick another one when the luau-lsp extension also listens on 3667.

alloy-luau.inlayHints.makeInsertable.description: A double click on a type hint writes it into the file.
